name: archboard-painter-wasm
responsibility: The Painter class that a page holds: one stage and the canvas its frames land on, painted by Vello on WebGPU, by Vello GPU on WebGL2 or by Vello on the CPU
description: It mirrors the stage (ADR 0085). A page states how the picture is seen, a picture's arrival and a departure as JSON through present, arrive and depart, and one numeric setCamera stays so that a glide parses no JSON on each frame. It picks under a point, resizes the canvas, and draws the frame of a moment of the page's clock, which answers whether it is still, moves traffic alone or moves. Each start function, gpu, webgl and cpu, takes the page's pace as JSON. The stage keeps its own clock and the parts of its strip canvases, so the crate holds no clock and no keeper beside the stage; the counting canvas that count_frame draws whole on lives here. This crate is a browser's: a native build of the workspace compiles it empty. It carries the hash of the sources it was built from, and the page refuses a build of other sources.
